description: Section 7.1 steps 2, 3 and 5: a thread whose root is not in the mailbox (a placeholder root names the conversation), a reply with only In-Reply-To, an Outlook reply whose References names the root and whose In-Reply-To names the parent, a two-message reference loop, a message that references itself, and a message without a Message-ID (its sha256: id is the root id).
